data.gender_notes: Kamlan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'klm' which means 'to seek' or 'to strive for'. In Islamic context, it represents the constant pursuit of knowledge, closeness to Allah, and righteous living. The name Kamlan carries the meaning “Sought after, Desired” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamlan usually hope their child will grow to embody sought after, desired and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamlan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
